regions.full_page: God bless you and yours. Many thanks for kind favor of June 29th. I hope that you are back from your trip to the S.est. that you found things favorable and may you profit in many ways. Hore when I get settled in this new location. Many thanks for your prayers. Please keep them up.

regions.full_page: God bless you and yours. Having noted your kind reques several weeks ago (Aug. 29) I hoped to find leasure for a few details. I've put it off again and again and its the same thing. Ny letters acumulate more and more. At al events I thank you (if I havent done it before anyhow). I hope those annoying problems in the S.Test have adjusted by this time. We'll continue our prayers that things improve. God bless you again.
